nights.title: Picture This
nights.name: Picture This
nights.extract: Picture This are an Irish pop rock musical band based in Athy, County Kildare, comprising Ryan Hennessy, Jimmy Rainsford, Owen Cardiff and Cliff Deane. In 2017, they released their eponymous debut album, which entered atop the Irish Albums Chart. In early 2019, they released their follow up album Mdrn Lv. Their third studio album Life in Colour was released in June 2021. On 26 April 2024 they released their fourth, Parked Car Conversations.

nights.title: Ole 60
nights.name: Ole 60
nights.extract: Ole 60 is an American country/alt-country band from Hawesville, Kentucky, formed in 2023, known for blending Appalachian storytelling with elements of grunge, southern rock, folk music, and traditional country. The band consists of Jacob Ty Young, Tristan Roby, Ryan Laslie, Colby Clark, Aden Wood (drums), Dwight McGlynn, and Dustin "Catfish" Fuqua. The band gained widespread attention in 2024 through breakout singles like "smoke & a light" and "Thoughts of You", and acclaimed debut album Smokestack Town in 2025.

nights.title: Puscifer
nights.name: Puscifer
nights.extract: Puscifer is an American rock group formed in Los Angeles by Maynard James Keenan, lead singer of Tool and A Perfect Circle. Keenan was the only constant member of the band and he considered the project to be his "creative subconscious". Later, frequent collaborators Mat Mitchell and Carina Round became permanent members.

nights.title: Ghostly Kisses
nights.name: Ghostly Kisses
nights.extract: Ghostly Kisses is the musical project of French-Canadian singers Margaux Sauvé and Louis-Étienne Santais. They are based in Quebec. Sauvé is signed to the British record label Akira Records. The name 'Ghostly Kisses' was inspired by the William Faulkner poem Une ballade des dames perdues, which includes the verse "And brush my lips with little ghostly kisses." Clash describes her music as having "a weightless quality, something that transcends the ephemeral to grapple with key facets of our lives."

nights.name: Guus Meeuwis
nights.extract: Gustaaf Stephanus Modestus "Guus" Meeuwis is a Dutch singer-songwriter. As part of the band Vagant, he scored several hits in the Netherlands and Flanders during the 1990s and first decade of the 2000s. On 24 May 2015, Meeuwis became the first Dutch language performing artist ever to play a fully booked concert at London's Royal Albert Hall.

nights.title: Oi Va Voi
nights.name: Oi Va Voi
nights.extract: Oi Va Voi are a British band formed in London, England in the year 2000. The band emerged from the UK world music crossover scene, enabling Jewish musicians to bring cultural styles into contemporary songwriting. The band blended their heritage with an emphasis on modern pop sensibilities reflecting their own individual interests in indie rock and alt-folk and the urban dance music of the clubs of London. The band takes its name from a Yiddish-derived exclamation popular in modern Hebrew meaning, approximately, "Oh, my gosh!".

nights.title: The Temperance Movement
nights.name: The Temperance Movement
nights.extract: The Temperance Movement are a British blues rock supergroup formed in 2011 by Glasgow-born vocalist Phil Campbell and guitarists Luke Potashnick and Paul Sayer. The rhythm section consists of bassist Nick Fyffe and drummer Simon Lea. The band released their Pride EP in 2012, and their eponymous debut studio album was released on 16 September 2013. Collectively the band have a rich history of experience, having previously played with Rooster, Ben's Brother, Jamiroquai, Ray Davies, The Waterboys and Feeder.

nights.title: KoRn
nights.name: Korn
nights.extract: Korn is an American nu metal band from Bakersfield, California, originally formed in 1993 by James "Munky" Shaffer, Reginald "Fieldy" Arvizu, and David Silveria, who were members of the band L.A.P.D. Their current lineup features Shaffer (guitar), Brian "Head" Welch (guitar), Jonathan Davis (vocals), and Ray Luzier (drums), the last of whom replaced Silveria in 2007. The band is notable for pioneering and popularizing the nu metal genre.

nights.title: Jack & Jack
nights.name: Jack & Jack
nights.extract: Jack & Jack are an American pop-rap duo from Omaha, Nebraska, consisting of Jack Johnson and Jack Gilinsky, based in Los Angeles, California. After success via the social media app Vine, the duo turned to careers as musicians. Their 2014 single "Wild Life" peaked at number 87 on the US Billboard Hot 100. They also featured on Jonas Blue's 2018 hit single "Rise", which peaked at number three in the UK Singles Chart in addition to charting within the top 20 of various other European countries and Australia.

nights.title: ElGrandeToto
nights.name: ElGrandeToto
nights.extract: Taha Fahssi, better known by his stage name ElGrandeToto, EGT or just Toto, is a Moroccan rapper from Casablanca. He has been the most streamed artist in Morocco for five consecutive years (2021-2025) and was the most listened-to artist in the MENA region on Spotify in 2021 and 2023. He is also the most viewed Moroccan rapper on YouTube. Fahssi is widely regarded as one of Morocco's best rappers of all time.

nights.title: Isaiah Falls
nights.name: Isaiah Falls
nights.extract: Isaiah Falls is an American singer from Orlando, Florida. He is best known for his 2024 single "Florida Baby". In September 2024, He was named Billboard's R&B/Hip-Hop Rookie of the Month.

en.who: Isaiah Falls is an American singer from Orlando, Florida. He is best known for his 2024 single "Florida Baby".
facts: He is best known for his 2024 single "Florida Baby".
In September 2024, he was named Billboard's R&B/Hip-Hop Rookie of the Month.

de.who: Isaiah Falls ist ein amerikanischer Sänger aus Orlando, Florida. Im September 2024 wurde er von Billboard zum R&B/Hip-Hop Rookie of the Month gewählt.
facts: Er ist vor allem für seine Single „Florida Baby“ aus dem Jahr 2024 bekannt.
Im September 2024 wurde er von Billboard zum R&B/Hip-Hop Rookie of the Month ernannt.

tr.who: Isaiah Falls, Florida eyaletinin Orlando kentinden bir Amerikalı şarkıcıdır. Eylül 2024'te Billboard tarafından R&B/Hip-Hop Rookie of the Month seçildi.
facts: En çok 2024 single'ı "Florida Baby" ile tanınır.
Eylül 2024'te Billboard, onu R&B/Hip-Hop Rookie of the Month olarak adlandırdı.

nights.title: Nemzzz
nights.name: Nemzzz
nights.extract: Nemiah Emmanuel Simms, known professionally as Nemzzz, is a British rapper who gained recognition in 2021 with the tracks "Elevate" and "2MS". He released his first mixtape Do Not Disturb in 2024, which debuted at number 17 on the UK Albums Chart.

en.who: Nemiah Emmanuel Simms, known professionally as Nemzzz, is a British rapper. He released his first mixtape Do Not Disturb in 2024.
facts: He released his first mixtape Do Not Disturb in 2024, which debuted at number 17 on the UK Albums Chart.
He gained recognition in 2021 with the tracks "Elevate" and "2MS".

de.who: Nemiah Emmanuel Simms, bekannt als Nemzzz, ist ein britischer Rapper. Sein erstes Mixtape Do Not Disturb erschien 2024.
facts: Sein erstes Mixtape Do Not Disturb erschien 2024 und stieg auf Platz 17 der UK Albums Chart ein.
2021 wurde er mit den Titeln „Elevate“ und „2MS“ bekannt.

tr.who: Nemiah Emmanuel Simms, sahne adıyla Nemzzz, İngiliz bir rapçidir. İlk mixtape'i Do Not Disturb 2024'te yayımlandı.
facts: İlk mixtape'i Do Not Disturb 2024'te yayımlandı ve UK Albums Chart listesinde 17. sıraya girdi.
2021'de "Elevate" ve "2MS" parçalarıyla tanınmaya başladı.

nights.title: Montell Fish - The Nest Tour
nights.name: Montell Fish
nights.extract: Montell James Frazier, also known as Montell Fish, is an American singer-songwriter. Formerly making music under the CCM genre, he switched to alternative R&B and neo soul. He has since signed to Virgin Music Group for distribution and released two albums under the deal: Jamie in 2022 and Charlotte in 2024.

en.who: Montell James Frazier, also known as Montell Fish, is an American singer-songwriter. He has made music in the CCM genre and later in alternative R&B and neo soul.
facts: Formerly making music under the CCM genre, he switched to alternative R&B and neo soul.
He has since signed to Virgin Music Group for distribution and released two albums under the deal: Jamie in 2022 and Charlotte in 2024.

de.who: Montell James Frazier, auch bekannt als Montell Fish, ist ein amerikanischer Singer-Songwriter. Zunächst machte er Musik im CCM-Genre, später wandte er sich Alternative R&B und Neo-Soul zu.
facts: Früher machte er Musik im CCM-Genre, dann wechselte er zu Alternative R&B und Neo-Soul.
Seitdem ist er für den Vertrieb bei Virgin Music Group unter Vertrag und hat im Rahmen dieses Vertrags die Alben Jamie (2022) und Charlotte (2024) veröffentlicht.

tr.who: Montell James Frazier, Montell Fish adıyla da bilinen Amerikalı bir singer-songwriter'dır. Önce CCM türünde, sonra alternatif R&B ve neo soul'da müzik yaptı.
facts: Önceden CCM türünde müzik yapıyordu; sonra alternatif R&B ve neo soul'a geçti.
Bu dönemde Virgin Music Group ile dağıtım anlaşması yaptı ve bu anlaşma kapsamında Jamie (2022) ile Charlotte (2024) albümlerini çıkardı.

nights.title: Saint Levant - AFANDI WORLD TOUR
nights.name: Saint Levant
nights.extract: Marwan Abdelhamid, known professionally as Saint Levant, is a Palestinian singer-songwriter and rapper. A multilingual artist, he became known for his 2022 song "Very Few Friends". As of August 2026, he has released two EPs and two studio albums, and has toured in the Middle East, Europe, the US, and Australia.

en.who: Marwan Abdelhamid, known professionally as Saint Levant, is a Palestinian singer-songwriter and rapper. He is a multilingual artist.
facts: He became known for his 2022 song "Very Few Friends".
As of August 2026, he has released two EPs and two studio albums, and has toured in the Middle East, Europe, the US, and Australia.

de.who: Marwan Abdelhamid, bekannt als Saint Levant, ist ein palästinensischer Singer-Songwriter und Rapper. Er ist ein mehrsprachiger Künstler.
facts: Bekannt wurde er durch seinen Song „Very Few Friends“ aus dem Jahr 2022.
Stand August 2026 hat er zwei EPs und zwei Studioalben veröffentlicht und ist in Nahost, Europa, den USA und Australien aufgetreten.

tr.who: Marwan Abdelhamid, sahne adıyla Saint Levant, Filistinli bir singer-songwriter ve rapçidir. Çok dilli bir sanatçıdır.
facts: 2022'deki "Very Few Friends" şarkısıyla tanınmaya başladı.
Ağustos 2026 itibarıyla iki EP ve iki stüdyo albümü yayımladı; Orta Doğu, Avrupa, ABD ve Avustralya'da turneye çıktı.
